ops.text: Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience upon 30 days' prior written notice to Vendor, in which case Vendor shall refund any prepaid Fees for the period after the effective date of termination. Vendor has no right to terminate this Agreement or an Order Form for convenience during a committed term.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 gives us only cause-based exits in a three-year term, so we have added a new 9.4 allowing Customer to terminate for convenience on 30 days' written notice with a refund of prepaid Fees for the post-termination period, and confirming Vendor has no convenience right during a committed term.
proposal.summary: Insert new 9.4: Customer termination for convenience on 30 days' notice with refund of prepaid Fees; no Vendor convenience right

mappings.element: No more than 30 days' written notice.
No Vendor termination-for-convenience right during a committed term.
